rows.working_definition: Foundation-model pretraining or large continuation training

rows.required_demand_driver: Project count × runs per project × GPU count × actual runtime × utilization

rows.working_definition: Model adaptation fine-tuning reward training and RL rollouts
rows.public_quantitative_example: One MIT paper reports approximately 24 hours on four GPUs for a fine-tuning experiment
rows.required_demand_driver: Project count × experiments × GPU count × runtime by model size

rows.working_definition: Scientific CPU-only HPC GPU simulation and AI-assisted scientific modeling
rows.public_quantitative_example: MIT documents FP64/high-memory selection and scientific projects; no annual hours by type

rows.working_definition: Biomedical projects and any project with restricted data
